name: blueprint/office-docs
description: Office document pipelines: pandoc/python-docx convert and extract via rh_run, the store keeps text + receipts, rh_text_extract pulls the structured fields
recipe: convert or extract the document text via CLI -> store the text and a receipt -> extract the structured fields -> publish converted artifacts
pitfalls: python tooling is local - a red receipt says install it
office files are binary - convert before extract
keep collect output small (text only, not the zip)
